_comment: Processor register (C04, DP-9). Machine-readable twin of docs/legal/processor-register.md; validated by docs/legal/check-processors.py. No secrets or contract text here: DPA copies go to the owner's evidence folder. All Ugandan-law statements are unverified, for lawyer confirmation. agreement_status values: not signed, in negotiation, signed, risk-accepted, not required.

processors.name: Appwrite Cloud
processors.purpose: Primary backend: authentication, database (all tables), file storage buckets (teacher documents, session evidence), realtime, functions (job tick).
processors.cross_border_note: Stored in the EU while users and the controller are in Uganda; whether this needs a transfer undertaking or consent under the Act is open (ADR 0006, ADR 0012 DP-7 note, lawyer brief Q20-Q23). Appwrite Inc. is a US-parented company, so onward access is also a question. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Obtain Appwrite's current sub-processor list and change-notice terms with the DPA; list not yet collected.
exit_procedure: Export every table and bucket with the core service export tooling plus the Appwrite console export (nightly export job if no point-in-time recovery, see memory.md question 7).
Verify counts against the export, store the export encrypted in owner-controlled storage.
Delete projects and keys in the console; request written deletion confirmation from Appwrite and file it as evidence.
Revoke all API keys (docs/ops/secrets-inventory.json lists them) and rotate dependents.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Record the refusal on the ticket. Replace the provider (preferred) or write a dated risk acceptance signed by the owner after the lawyer's advice; status becomes 'risk-accepted' with risk_acceptance_ref. Fallback noted in ADR 0012 option C: self-hosted Appwrite on EU infrastructure.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Fly.io
processors.purpose: Hosts the core service (FastAPI) that processes API requests and jobs and holds runtime secrets.
processors.cross_border_note: Requests are processed in Frankfurt; transient processing and logs only, no primary database (ADR 0003). Fly.io Inc. is US-parented. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Obtain Fly.io's sub-processor list with the DPA; list not yet collected.
exit_procedure: Redeploy the core service to the replacement host from the container image (Dockerfile in services/core).
Move secrets (docs/ops/secrets-inventory.json) and repoint DNS; run readiness checks.
Destroy Fly apps and volumes; request deletion confirmation; revoke FLY_API_TOKEN.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Record the refusal on the ticket. Replace the provider (preferred) or write a dated risk acceptance signed by the owner after the lawyer's advice; status becomes 'risk-accepted' with risk_acceptance_ref.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Resend
processors.purpose: Transactional email (receipts, session notices, safeguarding notifications, account email).
regions: Region chosen at account creation (EU acceptable; owner picks, ADR 0005)
processors.cross_border_note: Email addresses, names and message content pass through the provider; region choice affects the transfer analysis. Resend is US-parented. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Obtain Resend's sub-processor list (it is understood to use AWS; confirm).
exit_procedure: Switch the email adapter to the fallback provider (ADR 0005 names Postmark); re-verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC on the sending subdomain.
Delete the domain, templates and logs in Resend; ask for deletion confirmation; revoke keys.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Record the refusal on the ticket. Replace the provider (preferred) or write a dated risk acceptance signed by the owner after the lawyer's advice; status becomes 'risk-accepted' with risk_acceptance_ref. ADR 0005 fallback: Postmark.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Africa's Talking
processors.purpose: SMS for one-time passwords only (SR section 9).
regions: Not confirmed; vendor is Kenya-headquartered, delivery routes through Ugandan operators
processors.cross_border_note: Phone numbers and OTP text are processed outside Uganda (country to be confirmed). Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Obtain the sub-processor and carrier list; carriers are separate controllers of their own network data.
exit_procedure: Switch the SMS adapter to another gateway (or to email OTP, if the product allows).
Close the account, delete message logs; request confirmation; revoke the API key.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Record the refusal on the ticket. Replace the provider (preferred) or write a dated risk acceptance signed by the owner after the lawyer's advice; status becomes 'risk-accepted' with risk_acceptance_ref.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push (APNs)
processors.purpose: Push notifications to the parent and teacher apps. Payloads must carry no child names, addresses or message bodies.
processors.cross_border_note: Device tokens and notification payloads transit Google and Apple infrastructure. Apple is not a signable processor for APNs; terms are fixed (note for the lawyer). Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Google Cloud/Firebase publishes a sub-processor list; accept via Google's data processing terms in the Firebase console. Apple's terms are non-negotiable.
exit_procedure: Stop sending: unregister device tokens in Appwrite and the core service.
Delete the Firebase project; revoke the APNs key in the Apple developer account.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Google terms are accepted online (low refusal risk). If the lawyer objects, minimise payloads to 'you have an update' only and record risk acceptance for APNs, which cannot be negotiated.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Google Maps Platform
processors.purpose: Address pin, place search and travel-time estimates for matching.
processors.cross_border_note: Home addresses/coordinates sent for geocoding and routing leave Uganda. Home address is sensitive for a child (safeguarding). Minimise: send coordinates not names, cache results (SR section 9), never send child names. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Google Cloud publishes sub-processors; DPA via Google Cloud's data processing amendment, accepted in the console.
exit_procedure: Replace the maps adapter (SR section 9 requires adapters) with another provider; purge cached results older than the retention rule.
Delete the Google Cloud project; revoke keys; remove client keys from app builds.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Google terms are accepted online. If the lawyer rejects them, restrict to coordinates only or choose another provider via the adapter.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Sentry
processors.purpose: Error tracking with PII scrubbing before send (docs/ops/runbook.md PII rules).
regions: Choose the EU (Germany) region at project creation; US is the default if unchosen
processors.cross_border_note: Scrubbed events only: no request bodies, names, emails, phones or addresses by design (F08). Residual risk: free text in exceptions. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Sentry publishes a sub-processor list; obtain it with the DPA.
exit_procedure: Remove the DSNs from Fly secrets and app builds (the error reporter adapter falls back to the no-op).
Delete the Sentry organisation/projects; request confirmation; revoke the auth token.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Record the refusal on the ticket. Replace the provider (preferred) or write a dated risk acceptance signed by the owner after the lawyer's advice; status becomes 'risk-accepted' with risk_acceptance_ref. The error reporter has a no-op adapter, so Sentry can be dropped without code change.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: MTN Mobile Money (Collections and Disbursements)
processors.purpose: Subscription collections (request-to-pay) and teacher payouts. MTN is probably also an independent controller of its own transaction data (lawyer to confirm).
regions: Uganda (MTN Uganda; MoMo platform location not confirmed)
processors.cross_border_note: Payer/payee MSISDN and amounts shared with MTN; likely domestic. If MTN's platform is hosted abroad that is outside our control. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: Not applicable to us; MTN's API terms govern. Ask whether MTN will sign a DPA or only its standard API terms.
exit_procedure: Stop calling the API (feature flag in the payment adapter); settle pending transactions and reconcile.
Close the product subscriptions; keep payment records per tax law (C03 retention).
processors.if_dpa_refused: MTN is unlikely to negotiate. Record risk acceptance after the lawyer confirms the roles; the alternative is not to take mobile money, which is not viable for the pilot.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Airtel Money
processors.cross_border_note: Phase 2; same analysis as MTN MoMo. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
exit_procedure: Not integrated yet: nothing to exit. Before Phase 2, sign/record the agreement.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Same as MTN MoMo; do not integrate until the position is recorded.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Card gateway (provider to be chosen)
processors.purpose: Card payments, Phase 2; provider to be chosen (SR section 9).
processors.cross_border_note: Unknown until a provider is picked. Prefer a PCI-compliant hosted checkout so we never store card data. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
exit_procedure: Not integrated yet: nothing to exit. At selection, add the provider's real name, region and exit steps here.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Choose a provider that signs a DPA; the DPA is a selection criterion.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: Uptime monitoring vendor (Better Stack or UptimeRobot, owner chooses)
processors.purpose: Uptime checks and job-tick heartbeat; alert delivery to owner contacts.
processors.cross_border_note: Checks hit health endpoints only (no personal data). The vendor holds the owner's alert contact details (email/phone), which are personal data of staff. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
exit_procedure: Export the check list from ops/uptime.json (kept as code) and recreate in another vendor.
Delete the account; revoke heartbeat URLs.
processors.if_dpa_refused: Low risk: switch vendor (ops/uptime.json is vendor-neutral).
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA

processors.name: GitHub (source, CI, project board)
processors.purpose: Source code, CI secrets store and issue tracking. Must hold no personal data of children or parents: only developer/owner identities and CI secrets.
processors.cross_border_note: By design no production personal data. Risk is an accidental commit of data or secrets, handled by docs/ops/secrets.md and the secret scan. Legal position: unverified, for lawyer confirmation.
processors.dpa_link: TBD: link to the signed DPA copy (owner uploads to the evidence folder; never commit the PDF if it holds commercial terms)
processors.sub_processors_note: GitHub publishes a sub-processor list (Microsoft); the GitHub DPA is incorporated in its terms.
exit_procedure: Mirror the repository and CI to another host; delete the repository after confirming the mirror.
Rotate every secret stored in GitHub environments (docs/ops/secrets-inventory.json).
processors.if_dpa_refused: GitHub terms are standard; a refusal is not realistic. If the lawyer objects, self-host Git and CI.
processors.breach_contact: TBD: vendor security/breach contact address from the signed DPA
